content_sections.heading: NEHU Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for NEHU Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026 must fulfil the educational qualification requirements mentioned in the official notification. The required qualification varies according to the subject. Candidates should have a Postgraduate degree in the concerned or relevant subject with the required marks along with B.Ed./M.Ed. qualification and other eligibility conditions. Postgraduate degree in concerned/relevant subject with 55% marks or equivalent grade. B.Ed./M.Ed. with 55% marks or equivalent grade. NET/SLET/SET in Education or concerned subject, or Ph.D. in Education or concerned subject as applicable. The notification specifies subject-wise specialization and qualification requirements for Guest Faculty positions.

content_sections.heading: NEHU Guest Faculty Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Selected Guest Faculty members will receive remuneration based on the lecture rate mentioned in the notification. The Guest Faculty posts are purely temporary and remuneration will be paid at the rate of Rs. 1,500 per lecture subject to a maximum of Rs. 50,000 per month.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for NEHU Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the official NEHU website. Open the Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026 notification. Read the eligibility conditions carefully. Visit the online application portal. Fill in the required details. Upload the required documents. Submit the application form before the last date.

content_sections.heading: NEHU Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The appointment will be purely on temporary basis. The engagement will be for the current semester only or until regular faculty joins, whichever is earlier. Selection does not guarantee allotment of classes to any extent. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Interviews will be conducted in blended mode. The notification mentions that Guest Faculty appointment is temporary and based on university requirements.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in NEHU Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 29 Guest Faculty positions are available under the Integrated Teacher Education Programme.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for NEHU Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 07 September 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required for NEHU Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates should have a Postgraduate degree in the concerned/relevant subject with 55% marks, B.Ed./M.Ed. qualification and other eligibility requirements as applicable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of NEHU Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Guest Faculty members will receive Rs. 1,500 per lecture subject to a maximum of Rs. 50,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the job location for NEHU Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The Guest Faculty positions are available at North-Eastern Hill University, Shillong Campus, Meghalaya.

faq.question: Q6. Is NEHU Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026 a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is purely temporary and will continue for the current semester or until regular faculty joins.
